title: Yuu Solar Charge
description: Daylight charge resource and active cast ability.
body:
# Yuu Solar Charge

Daylight charge resource and active cast ability.

## Features
- Players charge power while standing in direct sunlight.
- Stored charge can be cast into a timed combat/mobility boost.
- Cooldown and charge economy are fully configurable.
- Includes speed, haste and resistance burst effects.

## Command
- `/solarboost [cast|status|on|off|reload]`

## Permission
- `yuusolarcharge.use`

## Compatibility
- Loaders: spigot, paper, purpur
- Game versions: 1.16.5, 1.17.1, 1.18.2, 1.19.4, 1.20.1, 1.20.4, 1.20.6, 1.21.1

## Notes
- Lightweight implementation with configurable behavior in `config.yml`.
- Built by **yuutaxd**.
